description:
The usa.gdt dataset is open in Gretl. It contains real US quarterly macroeconomic data from the Federal Reserve FRED database (1984Q1 to 2009Q3) with two variables: 'gdp' (real GDP in billions of chained 2005 dollars) and 'inf' (CPI inflation rate, annualized %).

Create a time series plot of the 'gdp' variable showing how real GDP has changed over time from 1984Q1 to 2009Q3. In the main window, click on 'gdp' to select it, then use the menu: Variable > Time series plot. The graph should show GDP on the y-axis and time (quarters) on the x-axis. When the graph appears, save it as a PNG file to /home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/gdp_time_series.png using File > Save as (PNG format) in the graph window.

metadata.data_source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED database, via Hill et al. POE5
